v1.8.0c (16 June 2023) |feed_title = Community Maps & Nametag Shop! |previous_update = [[v1.7.5]] |next_update = [[v1.8.2|Vigilante Update]] }} ==Description== '''v1.8.0''' is the fifty-sixth update to be released on Tower Defense Simulator, on the 9th of June 2023. This update was also given the name '''Community Maps Update''', as it added community maps. This version encompasses four updates, the main v1.8.0 Update (released 9 June 2023) and three minor updates, the v1.8.0a (released 15 June 2023), v1.8.0b (released 16 June 2023) and v1.8.0c (released on the same day as v1.8.0b, 16 June 2023). ==Additions== ===Maps=== *[[The Heavens]] (Survival) *[[Musaceae Kingdom]] (Survival) *[[Happy Home of Robloxia]] (Survival) *[[Honey Valley]] (Survival) *[[Area 52]] (Survival) *[[Atlas Colosseum]] (Survival) *[[Derelict Outpost]] (Survival) *[[Enchanted Forest]] (Survival) *[[Tropical Industries]] (Survival) ===Miscellaneous=== *Daily Nametag Store *New [[nametags]] **[[SparkleTime Nametag]] **[[Rich Nametag]] **[[Lightning Nametag]] **[[Sunset Nametag]] **[[Miami Nametag]] **[[Inverted Nametag]] **[[Retro Nametag]] **[[Noob Nametag]] **[[Pink Nametag]] **[[Purple Nametag]] **[[Green Nametag]] **[[Orange Nametag]] **[[Red Nametag]] **[[Blue Nametag]] :In '''v1.8.0a''': *[[Birthday]] modifier ==Changes & Bugfixes== *The towers on the triumph screen are now the towers you have in your loadout. *Changed the gamepass store tab icon. *In private servers, all regular and [[Elevators#Special Elevators|special elevators]] no longer have maps. Instead, they teleport you to a private intermission lobby, which includes additional maps. *The [[Glitchy Nametag]] is now given to players who have beaten the [[Hidden Wave (Legacy)|legacy Hidden Wave]]. *The [[Rainbow Nametag]] is now given through the [[Gift Box]]. *Partially fixed the [[Daily Store#Daily Skin Store|Daily Skin Store]] mostly only having [[Cold Front Crate]] skins on sale for most of the month. Now, [[Cold Front Crate]] skins have an increased chance of appearing there between the 14th and 21st of each month. *Fixed the [[Elf Camp]] [[Gamepasses|gamepass]] appearing in the store despite it being taken offsale. *Fixed the [[v1.7.5]] update log using incorrect images. :In '''v1.8.0a''': *[[Birthday]] modifier is now active on all maps. :In '''v1.8.0b''': *[[Birthday]] modifier is now disabled on all maps. :In '''v1.8.0c''': *Private servers changed. **The [[Elevators|elevator]] change pop-up now has an option "''Do not show again''", which prevents it from appearing every time you join a private server. **Community maps can now appear without overriding maps. **Players can now override maps without having the VIP gamepass. ***Players can override more than one map. ***Overriding maps now always starts a 25 second timer. **Players can veto maps more than once. ***Vetoing now always starts a 25 second timer. ==Official Update Trailer== [[File:Tower Defense Simulator- Community Maps!|thumb|750px|center]] ==Gallery== {{Gallery|Open = Yes| {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} DuckySkincrateUpdateMay2023.png AprUpdate2023.png ColdFrontThumbnail.png {{GalleryHeader|Icons}} CommunityMapIcon.png {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Images}} CommunityMapsPI.jpg }} ==Official Update Log== ''NOTE: Not everything here will be accurate as this is transcribed from the game's in-game update log. Several things may be incorrect and there may be things that are missing.'' ===v1.8.0=== {{UpdateLog| {{UpdateBanner|IntermissionLobbyIcon.png|Community Maps & Nametag Shop!}} {{UpdateH1|📜Update Log:}} {{UpdateH3|🛒[[Nametags|Nametag]] Shop (!)}} *You can now purchase [[nametags]] in the shop! *4 rarities: Common, Uncommon, Rare, Legendary {{UpdateThumbnail|NametagUpdateLog.png|The shop rotates new [[Nametags|nametags]] daily!}} {{UpdateH3|🗺️Community Maps (!)}} *⚠️THIS FEATURE IS PRIVATE SERVER EXCLUSIVE⚠️ *Vote for a ton of new community submitted maps in private servers! *[[Elevators]] in private servers will now send you to the Intermission Lobby *⚠️Community [[maps]] use a new reward system, which varies based off map difficulties *🛠️Join our community to learn how to submit your maps to the Community [[Maps|Map]]! *Added new [[Maps|map]] difficulty: 'Very Easy" {{UpdateMapBox|[[The Heavens]]|Theheavens.png}} {{UpdateMapBox|[[Musaceae Kingdom]]|Musaceaeking.png}} {{UpdateMapBox|[[Honey Valley]]|HoneyValleyMap.png}} {{UpdateMapBox|[[Happy Home of Robloxia]]|Happyhappyhappy.png}} {{UpdateMapBox|[[Enchanted Forest]]|Enchantedforest.png}} {{UpdateMapBox|[[Derelict Outpost]]|Relicofthepast.png}} {{UpdateMapBox|[[Atlas Colosseum]]|Atlascolo.png}} {{UpdateMapBox|[[Area 52]]|Area52.png}} {{UpdateMapBox|[[Tropical Industries]]|Industries.png}} {{UpdateH3|✨Other Additions}} *Triumph Screen now displays your [[Towers|tower]] loadout! *Added new 'Gamepass' store icon *Awarded '[[Glitchy Nametag|Glitchy]]' to [[Hidden Wave (Legacy)|Hidden Wave]] badge owners {{UpdateH3|🐛Bug Fixes}} *Fixed [[Daily Store#Daily Skin Store|daily skin shop]] rotation }} {{UpdateNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:v1.8.0}} [[Category:Modern Updates]]
